extraArgs.description: node_exporter's own TLS server (--web.config.file) and the supervisord collector are not supported, and neither are @file arguments or $(VAR) references, which could supply them. Use the subchart's kubeRBACProxy and tlsSecret values for TLS.

env.description: Tempo's extra command-line arguments (TEMPO_EXTRA_ARGS) and a bash startup file (BASH_ENV) are not supported. NKTP runs Tempo with the image's configuration, which enables OTLP receivers only.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Mount paths must be absolute and normalized, and must not replace /, /otel-lgtm, or Tempo's configuration, binaries, or startup scripts. NKTP runs Tempo with the image's configuration, which enables OTLP receivers only.
